provenance.calibration: PSI reference calibration: C, K and L fitted with Eq. (25) to three axial R = -1 failures (PSI tests PL-012, PL-073, PL-074) with the load-cell-corrected axial stresses (published stress x 1.1558).
provenance.Sigm1_TVEIT, Taum1_TVEIT: 271.6 MPa on the corrected axial-stress scale; Taum1 = 250/sqrt(3) MPa, lambda = -21.6 MPa.
provenance.A: Anchored on the PSI axial tests with nonzero mean stress.
provenance.stress_scale: The constants belong to the load-cell-corrected axial stresses (published x 1.1558) of the corrected workbook supplied by PSI (e.g. Uniaxial_2 at 271.6 MPa). With the published axial stresses (e.g. Uniaxial_2 at 235 MPa) the axial lives come out too long. Torsional stresses are the same in both.

notes.Sigm1_TVEIT, Taum1_TVEIT: fatigue limits [MPa] the constants were calibrated with; they replace the workbook Sigm1 and Taum1 for TVEIT2025 only
notes.npts_TVEIT: points per load cycle; 1001 gives lives about 0.02 decade shorter than converged
notes.min_blocks_TVEIT: cycles integrated before the stationarity test is applied
notes.max_blocks_TVEIT: cycles integrated at most; the life is then extrapolated from the damage of the last cycle (warning in the run notes)
notes.tol_alpha_TVEIT: relative change of the back-stress per cycle below which the cycle is stationary
notes.tol_damage_TVEIT: relative change of the damage per cycle below which the cycle is stationary
